events.name: Game.SessionStarted
events.doc: The desktop is up and the player's save is live. Packs load once, at app boot, before any save is chosen, so anything you write at load time (`SaveStorage`, mail, scheduled jobs, quest state) is discarded when the save rehydrates over it. Seed per-save content from here instead. Fires on every load, so guard one-time work with a `SaveStorage` flag.
